_comment: Which generated hair and beard models (library/hair) each 3D character wears. Applied to config/cast3d.json by tools/chars3d/apply_generated.py and by convert_pack.py when the cast is rebuilt from the pack. Hair colour is the character's own drawn hair colour unless given here. Characters not listed keep their sculpted hair: everyone who wears a hat, helmet, cap, hood up or head wrap (a generated hairstyle would poke through it), and Samurai, Judge, Flapper and Baby (no matching model).
